description:
Runs MetaPhlAn 4 and HUMAnN 3

* Optional short read quality control workflow (https://workflowhub.eu/workflows/336)
* Includes renormalizing and all regroupings to other functional categories (EC,KO.. etc)

Required inputs are paired end reads and databases.

Other UNLOCK workflows on WorkflowHub: \
https://workflowhub.eu/projects/16/workflows?view=default

Tool CWL files and other workflows can be found at:\
https://gitlab.com/m-unlock/cwl
name: HUMAnN 3 workflow
tools: interleave qc forward and reverse files for subsequent tools
merges arrays of files in an array to an array of files
profiling the composition of microbial communities
quality and contamination filtering of short reads
step needed to output filtered reads because there is an option to not to.

this is workflow specific step and creates a single file object. 
also merges reads if multiple files are given. (not interleaving)
